title: Your Third Week Checkpoint
devotional: Three weeks into this journey, pause and look at the direction of your life. You have learned to recognize triggers, examine the promises behind temptation, change your environment, stop negotiating, replace old patterns, pray when you are weak, and return to God after setbacks. Now ask yourself what is actually changing. Growth is not measured only by whether you have had a perfect week. Look for greater awareness, quicker obedience, stronger boundaries, and a deeper dependence on God. Let this checkpoint help you prepare for the final week.
mind_check: What has changed in the way you think about temptation since Day 1?
body_move: Review the physical and environmental boundaries you have created. Strengthen one boundary that still needs attention.
spirit_move: Spend time thanking God for His patience and grace. Ask Him to reveal one area where you need deeper surrender.
way_out: The biggest lesson I have learned so far is __________. The next change I need to make is __________.
prayer: Father, thank You for carrying me through these three weeks. Help me see the progress You are producing in me and remain honest about the areas that still need work. Give me strength to keep growing, humility to receive correction, and a heart that continually turns toward You. Amen.
action: Review Days 15-20. Write down three lessons, one area of growth, one recurring struggle, and one specific commitment for your final week.
